message.reasoning:
We need to decide: we are in jail, have $420 cash, 1 get out of jail free card. Options: pay $50 fine, use card, or roll for doubles. Need to consider strategy. We have three properties: St. James Place (orange), Tennessee Avenue, New York Avenue (also orange). No houses. Opponent Beta has three orange properties with 3 houses each (Kentucky, Indiana, Illinois) - those are red? Wait: Kentucky, Indiana, Illinois are red group. Actually orange group is St. James, Tennessee, New York. Beta has red group with houses. So we have orange monopoly but no houses. Could develop later. Need cash to build houses (cost per house: $100 for orange? Actually houses cost $100 for orange). We have $420 cash, could buy houses after leaving jail. Paying $50 reduces cash to $370, still enough to buy houses (need 3 houses each maybe). Using card costs nothing, keep cash. Rolling for doubles could waste turn and maybe not get out, but you have up to 3 attempts? In Monopoly, you have up to 3 attempts to roll doubles; if fail, you must pay fine and move. But here decision is just one action now; likely you can roll now. Rolling gives chance to move and maybe land on something beneficial (like Chance/Community Chest). But risk: if you fail, you stay in jail and lose turn. Since we have a card, best to use card to preserve cash and get out immediately. That seems optimal. Use card.

Public message: maybe say "I'll use my Get Out of Jail Free card." Could also be deceptive, but no need.

Make tool call use_get_out_of_jail_card with private and public messages.

function.name: use_get_out_of_jail_card
